objective: Small default-OFF in-process engineering episode composition, conditional on safe sealed peer APIs; not a new experiment, campaign or qualification.

peer_read_budget.metadata: Read sealed client/metrics reports, Parent candidate index, frozen probe references and sealed NominalServices handoff only.
peer_read_budget.source_inputs: Prefer nominal_client.py and nominal_metrics.py public replay/check/prepare/build APIs; inspect additional sealed dependencies only when required.
peer_read_budget.forbidden: Do not read unsealed native_services_smoke.py or other unsealed Role3 work.

go_no_go.go: A safe in-process public peer API provides bounded replay, all offered fates/raw-v2 capture and cancellation ownership without duplicating peer codecs.
go_no_go.no_go: If that API is absent, seal the precise smallest caller/API blocker; do not edit peers, duplicate their SSE/row mapper/capture codec or run a replacement client.

required_adapter_boundaries: Explicit experimental opt-in; dependency acceptance and Mayor exact-source approval remain separate prerequisites.
Inside Mayor-owned NominalServices only; no service spawning, subprocess, SSH, GPU or independent campaign owner.
Same clock and one future absolute offeredStart shared by runtime and recorder; preload/check Train/tokenizer/source/binding before start.
Reject a past start rather than retime. Preserve original absolute deadlines and cleanup reserve.
Run controller and five-request engineering replay concurrently; cancel and join both on failure and retain partial outcomes, raw-v2 capture and runtime journal.
Do not invoke natural metrics finalize for engineering or claim full-wall completion before Mayor cleanup.
Missing admission/ledger evidence remains missing/null; ACK never becomes admission-effect or qualification evidence.
No changes to accepted runtime/planner/scenario/permit/services or independently reviewed client/metrics.

validation_if_implemented.selected_suite: Only focused test_nominal_episode.py; no prior or peer suites.
cases: Shared future start, bounded concurrent CPU replay/controller and complete all-offered outcomes.
Default-OFF and missing/invalid/past-start or binding refusal before work.
Injected failure and cancellation preserve partial evidence and join both owned tasks.
validation_if_implemented.transport: Synthetic httpx.MockTransport only; no external HTTP.
validation_if_implemented.environment: unset PYTHONPATH, threads=1, no bytecode/autoload/cache, PYTHONHASHSEED=0, nice -n19, -B
validation_if_implemented.on_failure: Retain exact frozen source and all failures; no retry or adaptive change.

handoff: Exact API and source pins, source copies/diff if implemented, commands/results or precise no-go blocker, partial/cleanup evidence, limitations and verified SHA256SUMS.
prohibitions: No agents, broadcasts, model changes, network, GPU, SSH, Git, installs, Markdown, full-suite testing, service/campaign driver, Train Fixed/Eval work or new modeling/sampling.
